relationships.rationale: Full-coverage audits gate Document Set completion but remain a validation lifecycle rather than the packaging feature itself.
Manifest reproducibility constrains package integrity without sharing the package creation lifecycle.
Split fallback supplies a packaging mechanism but retains its own parser and failure states.
Several History actions depend on a current rebuilt index, while command dispatch and rebuild recovery remain distinct lifecycles.
Evidence export must honor History retention and archive state without collapsing export authorization into retention authority.
Artifact reconstruction consumes authoritative EventRecord replay but has a distinct package reconstruction outcome and oracle.
Shutdown mechanics are explicit while simultaneous outcome precedence remains unresolved; the tension is not synonymy.
Index publication and Grep performance share a seam, but correctness/publication recovery and benchmark acceptance have different failure oracles.
Discovery freshness consumes index generation truth but retains branch/worktree-specific invalidation semantics.
Remote cache eviction affects regex-index availability but must not be merged with query-completeness and matching semantics.
Canonical memory writes and index recovery depend on the Assistant-only memory authority boundary.
Cross-worktree status mutation projects canonical coordination state but has a distinct transaction and consumer lifecycle.
Worktree leases and SCM projections coordinate through canonical storage while retaining separate degraded-state and lease authority.
Identity-native open resolves through artifact routing and references, but its persist/open state machine remains distinct.
The runtime-artifact envelope carries routing fields, while envelope payload trust and reference resolution remain separable contracts.
Routing consumers use projection freshness and health, but routing integrity and projection-state transitions retain distinct failure behavior.
Published freshness and health depend on rehydration and checkpoint consistency without becoming the projector recovery lifecycle.
Analytics checkpointing and projection rehydration share checkpoint seams but differ in consumers, replay effects, and recovery oracles.
Phase acceptance covers the wider storage projector and analytics rollout while checkpoint semantics remain their own feature.
Writer fencing and atomic file promotion jointly protect durable mutation but have distinct lock and filesystem-replacement failure states.
Durable-store safety depends on resolving and protecting the application data root, while root selection and full crash safety are not synonyms.
General retention and bounded-history policy constrains evidence pruning, but cleanup control and pruning races retain a separate lifecycle.
Authoritative EventRecord replay depends on the segment-log wire and corruption-recovery contract, while index authority remains distinct.
